sourceSummary: RateCompass hosted marketplace benchmark and consumer comparison feed. Mortgage benchmarks are updated from public comparison-table rates where available. GIC benchmarks use the upper-middle public marketplace range where available. Official bank and Bank of Canada posted-rate pages are checked separately as validation references because posted bank rates can be higher for mortgages and lower for deposits than marketplace or negotiated rates.

benchmarks.sourceDetail: Median of the leading visible comparison-table rates from Ratehub 1-year fixed mortgage rates. Bank posted-rate pages are checked separately as a high-side guardrail.
benchmarks.reviewNote: Updated from the current public comparison table. This is comparison context, not a verified lender offer.

specialOfferPolicy.label: Specials Watch
specialOfferPolicy.mortgageRule: Flag a public mortgage offer when it is at least 10 basis points below the current marketplace benchmark for the same term.
specialOfferPolicy.gicRule: Flag a public GIC offer when it is at least 10 basis points above the current marketplace benchmark for the same term and redeemability.
specialOfferPolicy.benchmarkRule: Specials are shown as opportunity signals and do not replace the stable benchmark rate unless they become recurring marketplace pricing.
specialOfferPolicy.reviewRule: Verify eligibility, availability, account type, region, rate hold, minimum deposit, and product conditions before treating a special as a firm offer.

specialOffers.note: Public marketplace special signal. Verify lender eligibility, conditions, availability, and whether the rate applies to the user's mortgage type before relying on it.
